Package gui

Class GetTableController

java.lang.Object
gui.BaseTerminalController
gui.GetTableController
public class GetTableController extends BaseTerminalController
Controller for the 'Get Table' screen in Terminal Mode. Handles customer check-in via confirmation code or ReaderTag identification. This controller manages both guest and subscriber check-in workflows, including reservation retrieval for subscribers and code recovery for lost codes.

      public void initialize()
